import pyautogui, time, getpass, requests

time.sleep(0.5)

# shift-click at start of line 10 to select through line 10
pyautogui.keyDown('shift')
pyautogui.click(300, 392)
pyautogui.keyUp('shift')
time.sleep(0.5)

# indent the selected lines by one tab
pyautogui.press('tab')
